# **How Swipe transformed billing for Laxmi Computers**


**Mukesh Kumar, co-owner of Laxmi Computers in Gowlidoddy** , shares how Swipe helped simplify billing, improve record-keeping, and make everyday business operations more organised.


The journey of Laxmi Computers did not begin with a formal business plan. It started with Mukesh working at a mobile shop in Begum Bazar, where he gained practical experience in customer service, stock management, and basic billing.


Over time, that experience gave him the confidence to take the next step.


## **How Laxmi Computers started**


The retail experience Mukesh and his brother gained encouraged them to start something of their own.


That led to the launch of Laxmi Computers.


While opening their own computer shop was certainly an exciting milestone, managing its day-to-day operations came with several challenges.


One of them was billing.


The business needed a simple way to generate bills, manage customer transactions, maintain records, and reduce manual errors.


## **How Laxmi Computers discovered Swipe**


Mukesh heard about Swipe through a friend who explained how the platform worked and how it could make billing easier.


The team decided to give it a try.


What stood out immediately was how simple and intuitive it was to use.


Instead of dealing with complicated billing procedures, Mukesh and his brother only needed to enter the required details to generate bills.


There was no lengthy learning process involved.


Swipe offered the straightforward billing solution they were looking for.


## **What changed after using Swipe**


Swipe became part of the daily workflow at Laxmi Computers, making billing easier and more systematic.


Some of the key improvements included:


- Faster bill generation without the need to manually prepare and calculate every transaction.
- Easier access to previous transactions through better record-keeping.
- Fewer manual errors in billing and calculations.
- The ability to create professional-looking bills and receipts quickly.
- A simple system that could be used without extensive training.


With billing becoming easier to manage, the team could spend less time on paperwork and more time serving customers.


## **How Swipe helped improve customer experience**


Billing may seem like a small part of running a retail store, but it can have a direct impact on the customer experience.


Customers expect bills to be accurate, easy to understand, and provided without unnecessary delays.


With Swipe, Laxmi Computers was able to generate well-organised bills and issue receipts more quickly.


Improved record management also gave the team better visibility while handling customer transactions.


Together, these improvements helped make the overall billing experience smoother for customers.
